sensors.name: right light sensor RLIGHT (light from above)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the right light is above 75 %, drive forward at 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, drive straight through a dark tunnel without touching its walls, and follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads more than 75 % (bright)

branches.outcome: bright: drive forward at 30 % and never look at walls or the line

uncertainties: Your program does the opposite of what you said: in bright light it drives straight and never follows the line, and only inside a dark tunnel does it check for walls and follow the line.
Inside the tunnel with no line, the line-following part curves right, so the robot turns into a wall and stops instead of driving straight through.
You said the robot should follow the line again after the tunnel, but it stops at the tunnel wall and never comes out, and in bright light it drives straight anyway.
You said the tunnel has no line; the third scenario only asks what happens if a line does run on into the dark, which your program then follows.
